SCTP
       Namespace SCTP

DESCRIPTION
       These commands allows you to manage SCTP connections, including several commands that are specifically designed to query
       for or manipulate certain types of data. Data manipulation in this case refers to inserting, replacing, and removing data,
       as well as setting certain values.

HINTS
SEE ALSO
